Before using that label, the release SHALL identify critical functions, credible hazards/consequences, operating envelope, degradation/fallback/Recovery criteria, dependency risks, observation/escalation, browser/platform limits, backup assumptions, RPO/RTO objectives where meaningful, and materially independent assurance proportionate to consequence.
Recovery SHALL remain reachable independently of a failed module wherever technically possible.
Boot failure SHALL NOT automatically destroy/reset canonical user data.
Older code SHALL NOT write newer canonical state it cannot safely understand.
Updates SHALL preserve user branding, themes, terminology, workspace/layout, and localization preferences unless a migration is necessary and tested or the user explicitly resets them.
If future generators/templates own code regions, they SHALL distinguish generated-owned, user-owned, and ambiguous/mixed material. User edits SHALL NOT be silently overwritten.

OMN-FOSS-009: Public Omnevum capability contracts SHALL be more stable than the selected upstream implementation behind them. An upstream major release, fork replacement, or library substitution SHOULD be absorbed behind the adapter/compatibility boundary when semantic compatibility is preserved.

A dependency or fork that becomes permanently difficult to update SHALL trigger seam-narrowing, patch consolidation, upstream contribution, replacement, or reimplementation analysis before recurring merge burden is normalized as permanent architecture.
A changed or stale entry SHALL reopen only affected requirements/evidence/targets unless coupling requires broader review.
Tool choice is currentness-sensitive and SHALL be revalidated rather than permanently hard-coded by this MPES.
A queue item SHALL carry source identity/currentness, affected capability, urgency/consequence, initial disposition, and the exact trigger for deeper evaluation.
A security candidate may bypass normal feature batching but SHALL NOT bypass:
Before a material release and at justified maintenance checkpoints, the engineering system SHALL ask:
A feature request SHALL NOT jump directly from prompt to bespoke implementation when an existing capability/FOSS/integration can satisfy the underlying outcome.
The AI SHALL:
Tests SHALL NOT be weakened, filtered, skipped, quarantined, threshold-relaxed, or rewritten merely to make implementation pass.
A test written after implementation may be regression evidence but SHALL NOT be falsely described as historical RED evidence.
Material defects SHALL receive durable regression guards.
The engineering project SHALL NOT live only in chat.

A fresh qualified agent using only a clean clone, this MPES/control artifacts, normal source interfaces, and declared credentials/access SHALL be able to continue the project without original chat history.
At least one benchmark SHALL intentionally interrupt a nontrivial app/game implementation and resume with a fresh agent from durable project truth.
The durable Omnevum engineering controller, requirements, evidence, repository state, tests and release authority SHALL remain independent of the particular coding-agent host that executes work.

OMN-ENG-001: Before building an Omnevum-specific coding-agent runtime/daemon, benchmark current FOSS agent hosts/harnesses and official vendor agents on representative Omnevum work. Candidate families include OpenHands, SWE-agent/mini-SWE-agent/SWE-ReX, goose, aider, Cline, OpenCode, durable execution harnesses such as Relay, host-neutral agent adapters such as harness-class projects, qualified successors, and later entrants. Currentness SHALL remove or demote archived/read-only hosts from the active benchmark set rather than preserving them by historical popularity. The selected host MAY be replaced at any time without losing accepted engineering state.

OMN-ENG-002: Where the owner already pays for an AI subscription that officially includes a coding/agent surface, the engineering factory SHOULD prefer that zero- or lower-marginal-cost route when it passes qualification and current terms permit the automated mode. Current examples include ChatGPT-plan Codex, Claude-plan Claude Code/Agent SDK, and Google AI Pro/Ultra Antigravity; their entitlements, task scopes and automation interfaces are volatile and SHALL be currentness-gated. Provider consumer-web scraping or OAuth/session piggybacking is not a substitute for an official agent surface.

OMN-ENG-003: Agent-host qualification SHALL exercise noninteractive/structured output, actual sandbox/containment versus permission-prompt behavior, cancellation/timeouts, repository isolation, resumability, context handling, tool/command evidence, and failure reporting. A host's permission UI, read-only agent label, or provider "full auto" mode SHALL NOT be treated as OS/process containment without current evidence. A provider's own "full auto" or subscription allowance SHALL NOT bypass Omnevum's protected tests, authority tiers, release gates, or evidence integrity.

OMN-ENG-004: Multi-agent orchestration SHOULD reuse host-native subagents/worktrees/sandboxes when they satisfy Omnevum contracts, but the controller SHALL preserve enough neutral state to resume the same work under a materially different host/model when quotas, outages, terms, bugs, or quality change.
Engineering-agent authority SHALL bind the actual model/provider/runtime, tools, context/memory, sandbox, network, permissions, resource limits, evaluator, and target environment.
The subject implementation agent SHALL NOT be able to rewrite protected evaluator logic, holdout answers, mandatory thresholds, or release gates and then approve itself under the weakened criteria.

Project/candidate code SHALL NOT create trusted release completion simply by writing PASS. Claim-critical evidence should be captured/reconciled by CI, isolated tests, target environments, independent model/control paths, or qualified external review proportionate to consequence.
Official releases SHALL bind exact artifact digest plus source/dependency/toolchain identity sufficient for reconstruction and incident analysis.

Where cryptographic release identity or supply-chain attestations materially improve the accepted distribution profile, the release plane SHOULD evaluate mature open tooling/standards such as Sigstore/cosign bundles and in-toto-compatible attestations before designing bespoke signature/provenance formats. The chosen scheme SHALL bind the exact artifact and relevant source/build identity, expose verification instructions, preserve offline/long-term verification material where required, and distinguish integrity/provenance from safety. Identity-bearing transparency logs can create durable public metadata; keyless/public-log use SHALL therefore be an explicit release-profile decision with privacy implications rather than a hidden default.
Registry/Git/CDN disappearance SHALL NOT silently substitute different content while claiming exact reconstruction.
The accepted static artifact SHALL be deployable to GitHub Pages using a reproducible project-owned deployment path. GitHub Actions MAY automate the build/deploy but is not a runtime requirement.

OMN-RELSE-001: The engineering repository SHOULD use a qualified dependency-update bot such as Renovate or an equivalent mechanism to surface current dependency updates with changelog/context, but generated update PRs SHALL remain candidates subject to Omnevum gates.

OMN-RELSE-003: OpenSSF Scorecard or comparable external project posture signals MAY inform upstream triage, but popularity, score, badge, star count, or any single scanner SHALL NOT substitute for exact source review and Omnevum qualification.

OMN-RELSE-004: Automated update machinery SHALL support grouping/noise reduction, dependency dashboards or equivalent queues, immutable/pinned workflow identities where practical, and separate handling of major/breaking updates. Routine patch/minor updates MAY be automatically prepared and tested, but auto-merge is permitted only when the exact configured risk/profile gates make that behavior safe and all mandatory evidence passes.

OMN-RELSE-005: An upstream-security or dependency-update tool is itself a supply-chain dependency and SHALL be pinned/qualified/updated under the same currentness model; scanner compromise or stale vulnerability data SHALL not become a hidden trust root.

source.heading: 22.7 Automated FOSS license and source-obligation compliance

items.text: Aggressive FOSS code adoption SHALL be matched by aggressive automation of license/provenance obligations so compliance does not become the manual bottleneck that discourages reuse.

source.heading: 22.7 Automated FOSS license and source-obligation compliance

items.text: OMN-RELSE-006: The engineering/release plane SHALL evaluate mature FOSS compliance tooling such as OSS Review Toolkit (ORT), ScanCode Toolkit, REUSE/SPDX tooling, FOSSology, and qualified successors before building bespoke license scanners/report generators. The accepted pipeline SHOULD automate dependency/source inventory, license/copyright findings, policy evaluation, notices/attribution, SPDX/CycloneDX outputs, corresponding/source-archive reconstruction where required, and review queues for ambiguous findings.

source.heading: 22.7 Automated FOSS license and source-obligation compliance

items.text: Tool output is evidence, not legal truth. Ambiguous compatibility or distribution obligations that materially affect release licensing remain an external legal/rights gate, but the engineering system SHALL prepare the smallest precise question plus complete provenance/source evidence rather than escalating ordinary detectable obligations to the human.

Omnevum SHALL support local health/diagnostic state for release identity, storage/migrations, backup readiness, service-worker/update state, package integrity, connectors, sync, resource pressure, and critical liveness where applicable.
This SHALL NOT imply default collection or transmission of personal telemetry.
Support bundles SHALL be privacy-minimized and previewable/category-summarized before external handoff.
Generating diagnostics SHALL NOT automatically upload or grant external authority.
Every package/capability SHALL define cradle-to-grave behavior.
Retirement SHALL cover:

The MVP SHALL be feature-rich enough for repeated real use but SHALL NOT wait for every accepted future capability or domain. It SHALL NOT use disposable architecture that is known to require replacement for v1.

source.heading: 26.3 Definition of done for the app/game factory

items.text: through specify -> SDD/TDD -> implementation -> integration -> qualification -> packaging -> release candidate, without routine human coding, test repair, command transcription, CI choreography, packaging, documentation, or repeated continuation prompts. For an ordinary record-oriented app, the benchmark SHALL demonstrate that schema/manifest-driven scaffolding can generate a safe accessible localized baseline UI without bespoke boilerplate, while a specialized workflow may replace that generic presentation without changing canonical ownership.

source.heading: 26.3 Definition of done for the app/game factory

items.text: At least one benchmark SHALL be interrupted and resumed by a fresh agent from durable project state.

The exact v1 scope SHALL be frozen by a machine-readable acceptance profile plus a dated Capability Coverage Matrix/currentness snapshot before final qualification. New entrants discovered after the frozen qualification cut do not make completion logically impossible; they enter the successor maintenance queue unless they reveal a release-blocking security/correctness defect or disprove a required claim.
A blocked sub-branch SHALL NOT end the accepted scope while independent work remains.
- every MUST/HIGH accepted capability is implemented, generalized, integrated, or legitimately rejected/not-applicable;
A capable AI senior engineer receiving this MPES SHALL proceed autonomously toward successful completion rather than merely producing another plan.
The first execution cycle SHALL:

Speed SHALL be achieved by eliminating unnecessary work, solving the underlying problem rather than the first proposed mechanism, and reusing proven machinery. It SHALL NOT be achieved by hiding uncertainty, weakening requirements, violating rights/licenses, skipping validation, accepting unsafe automatic upstream updates, or creating unmaintainable integration debt.

The next normal action is autonomous execution of Section 30 and Phase 0, with parallel ecosystem/FOSS characterization, not another architecture-planning cycle. The engineer SHALL reopen this MPES only when implementation/research evidence establishes a material contradiction, missing requirement, changed owner direction, source/currentness invalidation, or a simpler stronger architecture.

Before first production implementation, the durable controller SHALL materialize the machine-readable Requirement Register, Acceptance Scenario Register, support matrix, Capability Coverage Matrix, FOSS/Upstream Register, Patch/Fork Delta Ledger, license/provenance state, Ecosystem Radar queue, risk/threat register, and Phase 0 acceptance profile required by this MPES. This is traceability/acceleration work, not a request for renewed owner approval.
A later MPES revision SHALL preserve this version as immutable history and use the normal impact, TDD/evidence, versioning, upstream-currentness, and CONVERGE rules.
